visual.general_description: Four-panel renal biopsy figure: two stained light micrographs (A, B), an immunofluorescence image (C) and an electron micrograph (D).
visual.detailed_description: A: Hematoxylin-and-eosin-type pink and purple micrograph of a rounded glomerulus-like structure with surrounding cellular tissue. B: Magenta and purple PAS-type micrograph of a rounded structure at the tissue surface with tubules below. C: Dark-background fluorescence micrograph with bright green ribbon-like staining in a rounded cluster. D: Grayscale electron micrograph with thick wavy grey bands curving around cells with dark nuclei.

Cell-dense tissue with many purple nuclei surrounds it on the right and above. Small clear tubular spaces with a pink-staining rim lie at the lower left. A white-lettered label A in a black circle is at the lower left.

visual.general_description: Four-column treatment summary graphic listing PLEX days, steroid doses, cyclophosphamide doses and rituximab doses.
visual.detailed_description: White background with a thin-bordered title box reading Treatment summary across the top. Beneath it four equal columns have dark navy header bars with white text (PLEX, Steroids, Cyclophosphamide, Rituximab) and light grey bodies with black bullet text. The PLEX body lists the days 7, 9, 11, 13 and 14. The Steroids body lists intravenous methylprednisolone 1,000 mg on days 5, 6, 7 and 8, then oral prednisone doses stepping down from 60 mg in weeks 1-2 to 2.5 mg in weeks 34-37, with the superscript markers a) after the 37.5 mg line and b) after the 2.5 mg line. The Cyclophosphamide body lists 1,000 mg at week 1, 750 mg at week 5 (dose reduced for HD) and 640 mg at week 9 (dose reduced due to neutropenia). The Rituximab body lists 1,000 mg at weeks 2 and 5 and 1,000 mg at week 31 (7 mo). No arrows or connectors are drawn.

A teal line labelled Anti-GBM starts at the y-axis near 115, drops steeply to about 16 near week 5, then to about 5 and 4 near weeks 9 and 10, and reaches about 0 by about week 19. An orange line labelled MPO starts near 67, drops to about 18 near week 5, then about 14 and 10 near weeks 9 and 10, about 3 near week 15 and about 2 near week 19, and then continues with markers on the 0 line at about weeks 28, 32, 41, 48 and 49. Above the lines, two solid red downward arrows sit side by side just right of the y-axis near the top, three dashed red downward arrows sit at about weeks 0-1, 4-5 and 8, and three solid red triangles sit at about weeks 1, 2-3 and 30. The chart has no legend box; the arrow styles are not explained on the image.
